items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: Yeah. He was lead alto. And naturally, we become good chums anyway

ctx.x: And he was first alto, too, wasn't he?
Yeah. He was lead alto. And naturally, we become good chums anyway; I mean, I knew him anyway.

Always the boys had a little blackjack game going -- in our spare moments, which wasn't many. Well, anyway, Rupert Cole comes in the band the first night, and he got kind of lucky there.
